I've been to Cuba 4 time around 2011. They had Internet and power then but was still ruled under comnuism. Many of my Cuban friends left to either Canada or the US. 

Shocking to see how it is now. It's a beautiful country and the people are the most friendliest going. 

Me and my late wife used to go back and take clothes for them. They loved it. We went to their houses to see family etc. 

I'll go back one day but there are many hard memories for me still.
